detailZh: 伊萨克·哈贾尔因手腕伤势将缺席在马德里举行的西班牙大奖赛，利亚姆·劳森继续为红牛车队出战
红牛车队确认，由于手腕伤势持续，伊萨克·哈贾尔将连续缺席第三场比赛；利亚姆·劳森再次顶替他，担任马克斯·维斯塔潘的队友；从本周五开始，请通过天空体育F1频道观看马德里新赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛的全部环节直播
天空体育的克雷格·斯莱特在荷兰大奖赛前披露了伊萨克·哈贾尔伤势的更多细节。
伊萨克·哈德贾尔将继续从手腕骨折中恢复，因此将缺席本周末在马德里举行的西班牙大奖赛。
利亚姆·劳森将连续第三场比赛替代哈德贾尔，成为马克斯·维斯塔潘在红牛车队的队友，而角田裕毅将继续留在小红牛车队。
哈德贾尔在暑假期间一次包含拳击的日常训练中，手腕的一块骨头出现细微裂缝（hairline fracture），这迫使他缺席了荷兰大奖赛、意大利大奖赛，以及现在的西班牙大奖赛。

在上周红牛提出申诉后，伊萨克·哈贾尔被恢复到摩纳哥站的领奖台席位。
红牛在声明中表示：“在赞德沃特和蒙扎为车队参赛之后，利亚姆将在本周末于马德里举行的西班牙大奖赛上继续与维斯塔潘搭档出战。
做出这一决定是因为伊萨克的恢复情况持续向好。虽然他尚未准备好回到座舱，但他将在马德里为车队提供支持。
红牛车队的所有人都期待着伊萨克能很快重新坐进驾驶座。

劳森在赞德福特的表现令人印象深刻，排位赛仅落后维斯塔潘零点一秒，并在荷兰大奖赛上获得第七名——这与他在2025年初被下调之前代表红牛车队的两场比赛形成了鲜明对比。
但是，他在蒙扎的二段排位赛（Q2）中被淘汰，部分原因是他的最快单圈被奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里阻挡。正赛中，由于引擎罚退他从维修区通道发车，但在一次早期静态发车重启时与奥迪车队的尼克·霍肯伯格发生碰撞，因此不得不更换前翼，最终恢复到第14名完赛，而维斯塔潘则登上了领奖台。
利亚姆·劳森与天空体育F1的克罗夫蒂对坐畅谈，透露如果去荒岛他会带上哪些赛道
角田裕毅在小红牛（小红牛）度过了两个表现出色的比赛周末，在荷兰大奖赛上比队友阿维德·林德布拉德高一个名次完赛，随后在蒙扎以第10名拿到一个积分。
蒙扎的比赛结果看来将遭到竞争对手奥迪就一次静态重新起步时的事故提出申诉，该事故中角田裕毅驶入了错误发车位，引发了额外一圈编队行驶。
这位26岁的车手上赛季被红牛放弃，他在意大利大奖赛前表示，希望能说服某支车队在2027年给他一个正式参赛席位。
在角田裕毅因意大利大奖赛重新起步时的这起事故而免于受罚后，奥迪已提交了“申诉意向”
"我自由了！很希望能听到那些通话，但还不是时候,"他说。"至少事情在朝好的方向发展，这很好。
"显然，我的首要目标是在一级方程式（Formula 1）中比赛。走着瞧吧。在这个世界里什么都可能发生。同时，也要明白拿到一个席位并不容易。"

detailEn: Isack Hadjar to miss Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid due to wrist injury as Liam Lawson continues at Red Bull

Red Bull confirm Isack Hadjar will miss a third straight race due to his ongoing wrist injury; Liam Lawson replaces him as Max Verstappen's team-mate again; watch every session of the Spanish Grand Prix at a new track in Madrid from this Friday, live on Sky Sports F1
Sky Sports' Craig Slater reveals further details about Isack Hadjar's injury ahead of the Dutch GP.
Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid as he continues to recover from a fractured wrist.
Liam Lawson will replace Hadjar for a third successive race as Max Verstappen's team-mate at Red Bull, while Yuki Tsunoda continues at Racing Bulls.
Hadjar suffered a hairline fracture in a bone in his wrist during the summer break in a routine workout that involved boxing which forced him to miss the Dutch, Italian and now Spanish Grands Prix.

Isack Hadjar was reinstated to the Monaco podium last week after a Red Bull appeal.
A Red Bull statement said: "After racing for the team in Zandvoort and Monza, Liam will continue to drive alongside Max at this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid.
"The decision has been taken as Isack's recovery continues to progress positively. While he is not yet ready to return to the cockpit, he will be in Madrid supporting the team.
"Everyone at Red Bull Racing looks forward to welcoming Isack back behind the wheel very soon."
An update from the Team ahead of the #SpanishGP 🇪🇸 pic.twitter.com/YEFCEgruOO

Lawson impressively qualified only one tenth behind Verstappen at Zandvoort and finished the Dutch Grand Prix in seventh - a complete contrast to his two Red Bull outings at the start of 2025 before he was dropped.

But, he went out in Q2 at Monza, partly due to being impeded by Oscar Piastri on his best lap. In the race, he started from the pit lane due to engine penalties but made contact with Audi's Nico Hulkenberg at an early standing start restart, so had to change his front wing and recovered to 14th, while Verstappen was on the podium.
Liam Lawson sits down with Sky Sports F1's Crofty to reveal his the tracks he'd take with him to a desert island
Tsunoda has produced two solid weekends at Racing Bulls, finishing a place ahead of team-ate Arvid Lindblad in the Dutch Grand Prix, before scoring a point by taking 10th at Monza.
The Monza result looks set to be appealed by rivals Audi over an incident at the standing restart, which saw Tsunoda pull into the wrong grid slot, triggering an extra formation lap.
The 26-year-old, who was dropped by Red Bull last season, expressed hope ahead of the Italian Grand Prix that he could convince someone to give him a seat on the grid in 2027.
Audi have lodged an 'intention to appeal' after Yuki Tsunoda escaped a penalty for this incident at the Italian Grand Prix restart
"I'm free! Would love to hear those calls, but not yet," he said. "It's good that things are going positive, at least.
"Obviously, my primary target is to be in Formula 1. Let's see. In this world anything can happen. At the same time, it's also knowing that it's not easy to have a seat."
